verdict.rationale: Mailgun documents Batch Sending with multiple recipients and Recipient Variables, plus Mailing Lists with Template Variables, enabling bulk send operations across many recipients at once; the MCP server also allows conversational bulk-style management actions. However, evidence doesn't show bulk operations across other resource types (e.g., bulk domain management, bulk route creation, bulk suppression management) beyond sending. missing for 10: documented bulk/batch APIs for non-send operations (domains, routes, suppressions at scale), independent hands-on confirmation of batch sending at scale, and MCP-driven bulk actions beyond single-item examples.
